text_description: Full runway look centered on a long, lightly structured coat worn open over a deep burgundy midi dress. The coat has a pale sky-blue base with an allover painterly scenic landscape print in soft greens, pinks, blues, and muted reds, including horizon-like bands, foliage/flower areas, and faded lettering near the upper chest; it features a wide pointed shirt collar, long sleeves, a straight relaxed fit, visible tan/brown front buttons, and a hem falling around the knee to upper-calf area. Beneath it, the burgundy dress is close to the body with a deep V-shaped neckline area partly framed by pale/white trim, and bold white asymmetric panels crossing the waist and lower hem, creating a wrap-like diagonal graphic effect; the skirt falls below the knee with a narrow, fluid silhouette visible between the open coat fronts. Styling includes a large round white pendant necklace sitting high on the chest, long colorful drop earrings, and a pink textured structured handbag carried at the side by gold-tone chain handles. The visible footwear is minimal and pale/white at the bottom edge, while the overall palette mixes soft pastel landscape tones with rich wine red and crisp white accents for an elegant, artful runway mood.

Beneath it, the burgundy dress is close to the body with a deep V-shaped neckline area partly framed by pale/white trim, and bold white asymmetric panels crossing the waist and lower hem, creating a wrap-like diagonal graphic effect; the skirt falls below the knee with a narrow, fluid silhouette visible between the open coat fronts. Styling includes a large round white pendant necklace sitting high on the chest, long colorful drop earrings, and a pink textured structured handbag carried at the side by gold-tone chain handles. The visible footwear is minimal and pale/white at the bottom edge, while the overall palette mixes soft pastel landscape tones with rich wine red and crisp white accents for an elegant, artful runway mood.
